purpose: falsifiable check for information beyond class prototypes, not automatic proof of rich knowledge
teacher_spaces: third official pretrained teacher if input contract is valid
targets: log RMS of XYZ-averaged 20-800Hz band-limited acceleration
log crest factor of the same signal
log Pearson kurtosis of the same signal
filter: per-axis fourth-order Butterworth 20-800Hz SOS zero-phase at verified 4000Hz; remove per-axis mean; discard first and last 0.1 seconds for descriptor computation
spectral_descriptor: Welch 512-point segments on trimmed band-passed window, integrate PSD in fixed intervals, average axis powers before ratios
readout_fit: recording-balanced contact TRAIN windows only, StandardScaler on hidden and targets, multioutput Ridge alpha10, fixed in advance
evaluation: contact window/recording error first; then radar recording mean of readout predictions; no instantaneous cross-modal pairing assumed
baselines: oracle true-class training contact descriptor mean
oracle true-class training teacher embedding mean passed through readout
primary_metric: MAE divided by TRAIN target std, equal recording weighting; R2 and rank diagnostics descriptive only with 8 records
gate: do not interpret a radar target as successfully transferred if heldout contact readout is not better than the class-only baseline for that target
limitations: contact data are intermittent within radar recordings
amplitude readouts may reflect mounting/gain rather than failure
only class-level training bags prevent identifying detailed within-class correspondence
descriptor_axis_rule: RMS pooled across time/XYZ; crest and Pearson kurtosis averaged across axes before natural log; Welch axis powers averaged before band ratios
